meta.name: Clockwork Cinder Endorsement
meta.description: An intricate brass ledger forged by The Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate. Its steam-driven gears mechanically calculate exchange rates, earning the respect of deep-bore merchants like the Ochre Toad. When placed within a homestead, it grants a permanent depth discount at vendors, but only if you are working within the Pewter Cinder brackets (above 250m).
